title: Structured intake & prioritization flow for commitments, invoicing mapping, and marketplace cost requests
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a repeatable intake and prioritization workflow for non-bug customer requests related to pricing/packaging and billing: specifically committed spend requests, invoicing adjustments, marketplace billing mappings, and cross-org cost allocation. The outcome will be (1) a single intake form + routing rules, (2) a scoring rubric to prioritize engineering/finance work, (3) escalation decision rules for legal/finance, and (4) templates and dashboards for tracking SLA and implementation status.
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical intake form exists (Google Form + CRM mapping) capturing required fields for commitments, invoicing, marketplace mapping, and cost allocation
Automated routing rules created in Zendesk/Linear/CRM to assign to the right owner within 24 hours
A documented prioritization rubric with scoring thresholds for fast-track, standard, and backlog queues
Integration points documented: how requests surface to Finance (invoicing team), Billing ledger, and Engineering (console/billing API) with example PR templates
SLA KPIs defined and visible in a dashboard: initial response (24h), decision (5 business days), implementation ETA (by priority), and closure
At least two customer scenarios validated with Sales/CS: committed spend contract change and marketplace fee remap
steps: Draft intake form fields: customer name, contract ID, request type (commitment/invoice/marketplace/allocation), amount/estimate, desired outcome, urgency, customer tier, legal terms implicated, supporting docs link, contact info
Map intake form fields to CRM properties (SFDC) and create a Zendesk/Linear webhook to create PM ticket with standardized metadata
Define initial triage owner: Commercial Ops for commercial questions, Billing.engineering for implementation work, Finance for invoicing/legal implications
Create a 0-100 scoring rubric combining customer impact, revenue at stake, technical effort (T-shirt), compliance risk, and strategic alignment
Define routing rules for scores: 75+ fast-track (exec review + engineering sprint allocation), 40-74 planned (normal roadmap/planning cadence), <40 backlog
Document triggers for immediate legal/finance review: contract amendment required, >$250k ARR impact, regulatory/marketplace tax implications
Publish templates: decision memo, legal scope doc, engineering implementation checklist, PRD stub for billing changes
Build dashboard in Looker for SLA and queue health; add alerting for aging requests >10 business days
Run pilot with Sales/CS on 4 live tickets over 2 weeks and incorporate feedback
Ship final playbook to Confluence and communicate via PM all-hands and Sales guild
triage_matrix: Score components: Customer Impact (0-30), Revenue at Risk (0-30), Effort (0-20, lower is better => invert when scoring), Legal/Compliance Risk (0-10), Strategic Alignment (0-10)
Fast-track threshold: total >= 75 => assign Exec review + prioritized engineering slot; standard SLA: decision within 5 business days
Planned threshold: 40 <= total < 75 => schedule into next planning cycle, owner must provide scoped ETA within 7 business days
Backlog threshold: total < 40 => deferred, logged monthly prioritization review; CS must communicate expected timeline to customer
Tiebreakers: Higher customer NPS + long-term roadmap dependency + single-customer revenue priority takes precedence

final_notes: This ticket creates a lightweight, auditable, cross-functional triage flow for commercial finance requests that balances speed and risk. The playbook will be iterated post-pilot and folded into the broader Pricing & Packaging triage runbook. Ensure each closed ticket contains a Decision Memo linked to the contract and billing ledger for auditability.
